name: 全球海洋大气腐蚀环境评估平台

so2AutoBackend.status: code-ready; production requires CAMS_ADS_API_KEY and Vercel deployment
so2AutoBackend.secretPolicy: server-only; never exposed to GitHub Pages/browser/result JSON
so2AutoBackend.async: ADS submit -> jobId -> browser polling/resume -> NetCDF download/parse

current.cyclePolicy: safe latest cycle; on ADS rejection back off by 12 h up to 3 cycles

scienceModel.camsSeaSaltBasis: RH80 mass and size; /4.3 dry-mass conversion; RH-normalized diameter
scienceModel.camsMissingBinPolicy: CAMS-valid bins retained; only missing bins use Proxy fill; missing is never zero
scienceModel.proxy: continuous distance factor + single fetch factor
scienceModel.localSpray: independent 35um and 75um decay scales; calibration required
scienceModel.wetDeposition: dimensionally closed scavenging-column model; disabled until Lambda/H explicitly supplied
scienceModel.isoSo2: CAMS Auto qSO2 -> Pc=q*rho*1e9 -> Pd=0.8Pc; manual Pc/Pd remains explicit override; missing remains missing
scienceModel.isoChloride: engineering JCl separated from ISO 9225-equivalent Sd; user may supplement measured/equivalent Sd for formal ISO

calculabilityLevels.L1: Environment Screening remains computable when SO2/Sd are unavailable
calculabilityLevels.L2: Engineering Corrosion Screening when traceable SO2 Pd exists
calculabilityLevels.L3: Formal ISO 9223 requires traceable Pd plus ISO 9225-equivalent Sd and complete Historical coverage

manualInputs.so2Pc: ug/m3; manual override only when Auto unavailable or project measurement preferred
manualInputs.isoSd: mg/(m2*d); ISO 9225 wet-candle equivalent chloride deposition
manualInputs.gis: optional fixed upwind sea distance/fetch override for engineering screening only
manualInputs.wet: optional scavenging rate and effective column height; remains off by default

calibration.status: V3.2.8 evidence retained; V3.3.x corrosion calibration disabled pending contemporaneous metadata

startupPolicy.formalIsoOutputRule: Historical complete coverage + traceable Pd + ISO-equivalent Sd
startupPolicy.screeningRule: L1 always remains available; L2 may use engineering chloride only when explicitly labelled non-formal
